mapper.sql: SELECT ID, YEAR, MONTH, FACTORY_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_DESC, LOCATION_TYPE, SALE_QTY, ORDER_QTY, REMARK, IS_DELETE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME FROM T_MP_HISTORY_SALE_QTY
mapper.select:
SELECT d.*,
CEIL((if(d.AUG_QTY < 0, 0, d.AUG_QTY) * d.FACTOR_VALUE)) STOCK_QTY FROM ( SELECT c.*, CASE
WHEN msf.FACTOR_VALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE msf.FACTOR_VALUE END FACTOR_VALUE FROM ( SELECT b.FACTORY_CODE, b.PRODUCT_CODE, MAX( b.PRODUCT_DESC ) PRODUCT_DESC, b.LOCATION_TYPE, SUM( b.SALE_QTY ) SALE_QTY, CEIL( SUM( b.SALE_QTY ) / #{month}) AUG_QTY, MAX( b.PATTERN ) PATTERN, MAX( b.BRAND ) BRAND, MAX( b.PRO_SIZE ) PRO_SIZE, MAX( b.SPECIFICATIONS ) SPECIFICATIONS FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT mhsq.FACTORY_CODE, mhsq.`year`, mhsq.`month`, mhsq.LOCATION_TYPE, mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE, mhsq.PRODUCT_DESC, mhsq.SALE_QTY, mpi.PATTERN, mpi.BRAND, mpi.PRO_SIZE, mpi.SPECIFICATIONS, mpi.TIRE_TYPE, CONCAT( YEAR, LPAD( MONTH, 2, '0' )) yearMonth FROM t_mp_history_sale_qty mhsq LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_info mpi ON mpi.IS_DELETE = 0 and mhsq.FACTORY_CODE = mpi.FACTORY_CODE and mhsq.PRODUCT_CODE = mpi.PRODUCT_CODE where mhsq.IS_DELETE = 0 ) a WHERE a.yearMonth >= #{startYearMonth} AND a.yearMonth <= #{endYearMonth} AND a.tire_type = #{tireType} ) b GROUP BY b.FACTORY_CODE, b.LOCATION_TYPE, b.PRODUCT_CODE ) c LEFT JOIN t_mdm_stock_factor msf ON msf.IS_DELETE = 0 and c.FACTORY_CODE = msf.FACTORY_CODE AND c.LOCATION_TYPE = msf.LOCATION_TYPE AND c.AUG_QTY >= msf.VALUE_MIN AND c.AUG_QTY <= msf.VALUE_MAX ) d
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MP_HISTORY_SALE_QTY mpDaySale JOIN (SELECT YEAR(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE) AS `YEAR`, MONTH(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE) AS `MONTH`, mpDayHisSale.FACTORY_CODE, mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_CODE, MAX(mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_DESC) AS PRODUCT_DESC, mpDayHisSale.LOCATION_TYPE, SUM(IFNULL(SALE_QTY, 0)) AS SALE_QTY, SUM(IFNULL(ORDER_QTY, 0)) AS ORDER_QTY, MAX(mpDayHisSale.CREATE_BY) AS CREATE_BY, NOW(), 0 FROM T_MP_DAY_HISTORY_SALE_QTY mpDayHisSale WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY YEAR(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE), MONTH(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE), mpDayHisSale.FACTORY_CODE, mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_CODE, mpDayHisSale.LOCATION_TYPE) mpDayHisSale ON mpDayHisSale.`YEAR` = mpDaySale.`YEAR` AND mpDayHisSale.`MONTH` = mpDaySale.`MONTH` AND mpDayHisSale.FACTORY_CODE = mpDaySale.FACTORY_CODE AND mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_CODE = mpDaySale.PRODUCT_CODE AND mpDayHisSale.LOCATION_TYPE = mpDaySale.LOCATION_TYPE SET mpDaySale.SALE_QTY = mpDayHisSale.SALE_QTY, mpDaySale.ORDER_QTY = mpDayHisSale.ORDER_QTY, mpDaySale.UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE mpDaySale.IS_DELETE = 0 AND mpDaySale.LOCATION_TYPE != '下架'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MP_HISTORY_SALE_QTY (`YEAR`, `MONTH`, FACTORY_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_DESC, LOCATION_TYPE, SALE_QTY, ORDER_QTY, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, IS_DELETE) SELECT YEAR(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE) AS `YEAR`, MONTH(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE) AS `MONTH`, mpDayHisSale.FACTORY_CODE, mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_CODE, MAX(mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_DESC) AS PRODUCT_DESC, mpDayHisSale.LOCATION_TYPE, SUM(IFNULL(SALE_QTY, 0)) AS SALE_QTY, SUM(IFNULL(ORDER_QTY, 0)) AS ORDER_QTY, MAX(mpDayHisSale.CREATE_BY) AS CREATE_BY, NOW(), 0 FROM T_MP_DAY_HISTORY_SALE_QTY mpDayHisSale WHERE mpDayHisSale.LOCATION_TYPE != '下架' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MP_HISTORY_SALE_QTY mpDaySale WHERE mpDaySale.IS_DELETE = 0 AND YEAR(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE) = mpDaySale.`YEAR` AND MONTH(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE) = mpDaySale.`MONTH` AND mpDayHisSale.FACTORY_CODE = mpDaySale.FACTORY_CODE AND mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_CODE = mpDaySale.PRODUCT_CODE AND mpDayHisSale.LOCATION_TYPE = mpDaySale.LOCATION_TYPE) GROUP BY YEAR(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE), MONTH(mpDayHisSale.ORDER_DATE), mpDayHisSale.FACTORY_CODE, mpDayHisSale.PRODUCT_CODE, mpDayHisSale.LOCATION_TYPE
